model.tooltip: Select the AI model to use for caption generation

quantization.tooltip: Choose between speed and quality. 8-bit is recommended for most users

prompt_style.tooltip: Select the style of caption you want to generate

caption_length.tooltip: Control the length of the generated caption

max_new_tokens.tooltip: Maximum number of tokens to generate. Higher values allow longer captions

temperature.tooltip: Control the randomness of the output. Higher values make the output more creative but less predictable

top_p.tooltip: Control the diversity of the output. Higher values allow more diverse word choices

top_k.tooltip: Limit the number of possible next tokens. Lower values make the output more focused

custom_prompt.tooltip: Custom prompt template. If empty, will use the selected prompt style

memory_management.tooltip: Choose how to manage model memory. 'Keep in Memory' for faster processing, 'Clear After Run' for limited VRAM, 'Global Cache' for fastest processing if you have enough VRAM

extra_options.tooltip: Additional options to customize the caption generation
